about: Recursive Rust target/ cleaner with native scheduling
root_help: Scan root (default: config.toml or current directory)
sweep_help: Clean stale build artifacts (the default command)
force_help: Run even if a build is active
enable_help: Install or update the weekly schedule
status_help: Show schedule status and the latest run
invalid_days: Retention must be at least one day
invalid_schedule: Weekday must be 0–6 and hour must be 0–23
invalid_path: Scheduler paths must be valid Unicode without control characters
unsupported: Scheduling is not supported on this OS
process_unavailable: Cannot inspect running processes; cleanup aborted
wizard: rcleaner setup — Esc or Ctrl+C to cancel
done: Setup complete. Preview with: rcleaner sweep --dry-run
path_help: All Cargo projects below this directory will be scanned
confirm_help: Select Yes or No with ↑↓, then Enter
missing_cargo: Cannot find Cargo. Install a Rust toolchain or add cargo to PATH.
metadata_failed: Could not read Cargo project metadata
self_target: Refusing to clean the running executable: {0}. Install rcleaner outside target/.
missing_home: Cannot determine an absolute home directory
